remarks: Experience high-rise living at its finest in this stunning 7th-floor condo at The Hayes House, nestled in the heart of downtown Stamford. This spacious one-bedroom residence boasts unobstructed east-facing panoramic views, bathing the open-concept living and sizable dining area in natural light. Elegant hardwood parquet floors flow throughout, adding warmth and sophistication. The expansive primary bedroom serves as a true retreat, comfortably fitting a king-size bed with additional space for a sitting area or workspace. Thoughtfully designed with two sizable closets, it provides ample storage for effortless organization. Wake up to sweeping city and treetop views, creating a serene start to each day. The modern kitchen features sleek cabinetry, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. A stylishly updated bathroom and abundant closet space complete the unit. Step onto your private balcony and take in breathtaking skyline and lush tree-lined views. This full-service building offers first-class amenities, including a live-in superintendent, full-time door staff, a fitness facility, and private storage. Reserved garage parking and ample guest parking provide added convenience. With heat, hot water, and central air included-plus a prime location walkable to Stamford's vibrant restaurants, nightlife, and shopping with easy access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway-this is a must-see opportunity for sophisticated urban living!
